publishedfiledetails.description:
Added ESC flashlight, open the menu to automatically zoom in on the flashlight (light angle: 123, light range: 900, brightness: 0.35)
There is a certain misalignment of the UI that I don't have the ability to fix
Due to the modification of the maximum value of the adjustment range in ingamemainmenu.res, the above parameters are the minimum values that can be adjusted in the menu
